_source: Each entry is a claim our profile (gdl/designsys/shockwave.json) or its README made that Shockwave's own pages contradict, found by the grammar measurement of 2026-10-22: every page and popup of seeds/Shockwave 1035.gdl, 725, 720, 1525, 1535, 525, 535 and 320, read with gdl.project (each control's rect, look, caption and font) beside its renders, and read again for this ledger - the seed's button art compared with the kit's files pixel for pixel, its fonts over every state. `template` is what those pages do, off the seed and pages named; the region frame (panels[series].frame) is the same seeds measured by tests/measure_series.py frame_of. `python -m gdl.designsys audit shockwave` checks every resolution against the profile, the README and the frame as they stand.

entries.reason: The 14 pt floor the toolkit checks (gdl.spec MIN_BODY_POINT_SIZE; docs/design-rules.md section 2): a caption under it is refused, so the profile lifts the template's 12 pt captions to 14, as type.button says.
entries.here: Nothing is under 14 pt, the toolkit's floor: the template's tab, rail and footer captions are 12 pt, and here they are 14.

fix.says: the seed's 12 pt lifted to the 14 pt floor

entries.evidence: Main SD's buttons: PointSize 12 on SD PC to SD AUX, Display On/Off/Mute, Screen Control, Lighting Control, Audio Control, Volume Mute, Room Mode, Help and Power Down; Display Label and Volume Label 18; Date/Time 14.

entries.claim: README Visual foundations: at least 12 px between touchable controls, no more than nine buttons in one group, place things on GUI Designer's 10 px nudge.

template.does: The template stands its source tabs 1 px apart (152 wide from x 169, one every 153 px) and its Display buttons 4 px apart (80 deep at y 170, 254 and 338), and places them off the 10 px grid: tabs at 169, 322 and 475, rail keys at x 29.

entries.reason: The 2 mm gap the toolkit checks between touch targets and Extron's documented nine-button and spacing standards (docs/design-rules.md section 2), which a designer's own controls keep; the template's own sets are the owner's exception (2026-10-22), kept as one set at the step the frame measures by the region components.
entries.here: Your own controls keep 2 mm apart, nine to a group, on the 10 px nudge - Extron's Design Standards. The template's own sets stand as it draws them - its tabs 1 px apart, its Display buttons 4 - and the region components draw them so.

fix.readme: Extron's Design Standards, which its own templates do not always keep

entries.evidence: Main SD's SD PC, SD Laptop and SD Blu-ray at x 169, 322 and 475 (152 wide); Display On, Off and Mute at 29,170, 29,254 and 29,338 (120x80).
